'''Kenshō Ono''' ('''小野賢章''' ''Ono Kenshō'', born October 5, 1989 in {{wp|Fukuoka Prefecture}}) is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. He played his most prominent role, [[Alain]], during {{aniseries|XY}}. He was married to fellow voice actor [[Kana Hanazawa]] from 2020 to 2025.
